title: centaurea ovina subsp. caprina
intro: Centaurea ovina subsp. caprina, commonly known as Sheep's Fescue, is a subspecies of the Centaurea ovina plant, belonging to the daisy family. This herb is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea ovina subsp. caprina are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, calm digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
